P1.2.text: Butler National Corporation specializes in aerospace solutions and management services, including modifications.

P1.3.text: AVCON RECEIVES FAA STC FOR HONEYWELL AEROSPACE REPLACEMENT EGPWS ON BOMBARDIER AND LEARJET AIRCRAFT

P1.4.text: BUTLER NATIONAL CORPORATION ANNOUNCES INCREASE TO STOCK REPURCHASE PROGRAM

P1.5.text: Butler National Corporation is an aerospace-focused holding company that delivers engineering, aircraft modifications, electrical systems integration, commercial and defense electronics, and professional management services. Our businesses support commercial operators, defense partners, and original equipment manufacturers.

P1.6.text: Our primary operations include Avcon Industries, BNC Tempe, and the professional services segment anchored by the Boot Hill Casino. Together, these businesses combine advanced engineering with reliable service delivery to support long-term growth.

P1.8.text: Butler National Corporation is comprised of multiple key subsidiaries operating across industries such as aerospace, avionics, defense, and professional services.

P1.9.text: Avcon provides FAA-approved aircraft modifications, engineering, avionics and electrical systems integration, and special mission solutions.

P1.10.text: BNC Tempe supplies commercial and defense electronics, wiring harnesses, and system controls to OEMs and government agencies.

P1.11.text: Our professional services segment provides management and operational expertise in gaming and hospitality.

P1.12.text: Butler National offers opportunities across engineering, avionics, electronics manufacturing, and management services. Explore open roles across our business units.

P1.13.text: Subscribe to receive Butler National Corporation updates and investor communications.

P2.2.text: Aerospace expertise in designing, manufacturing, and servicing aviation products and professional services, managing Boot Hill Casino.

P2.3.text: Butler National Corporation is a public holding company with more than six decades of experience in aerospace engineering, aircraft modifications, avionics integration, special purpose electronics design and manufacturing, and professional gaming management services.

P2.4.text: Butler National is OTCQX listed under the ticker BUKS.

P2.5.text: Butler National oversees subsidiaries that provide:

P2.6.text: Aircraft modifications, avionics and electrical systems integration, and special mission solutions

P2.7.text: Commercial and defense electronics, wire/cable harness assemblies, and system components

P2.8.text: Professional management services for gaming operations

P2.9.text: This combination of engineering capability and disciplined operational management supports sustainable growth across our business segments.

P2.10.text: Our governance framework includes established committees, corporate policies, charters, and a code of ethics that guide responsible conduct across all subsidiaries.

P2.11.text: Our operating subsidiaries focus on aerospace engineering and modifications, commercial electronics, and professional management services.

P2.12.text: Avcon provides FAA approved aircraft modifications, engineering, avionics and electrical systems integration, and special mission solutions.

P3.2.text: Operates Avcon Inc. and Butler Avionics, supplies commercial and defense electronics, manages Boot Hill Casino & Resort, and runs KC Machine.

P3.3.text: Butler National Corporation oversees a group of aerospace and professional services subsidiaries that support commercial operators, defense partners, original equipment manufacturers and agencies around the world. Our primary operations focus on aircraft engineering and modifications, avionics integration, and commercial electronics design and manufacturing, with additional services provided through our professional management segment.

P3.4.text: Our aerospace subsidiaries deliver engineering, FAA-approved aircraft modifications, avionics integration, commercial electronics, wiring systems, and special mission solutions. These businesses support a broad range of commercial, defense, and government programs.

P3.5.text: Avcon provides FAA-approved aircraft modifications, engineering, systems integration and avionics for commercial and defense operators. The team delivers reliable airframe upgrades and mission solutions for a wide range of aircraft.

P3.8.text: Butler National – Tempe manufactures commercial and defense electronics, wiring and cabling harnesses, and system components for OEMs and government agencies. The team produces both custom assemblies and commercial off-the-shelf solutions.

P3.10.text: Butler Avionics provides avionics sales, installations, upgrades, and repair services, supporting Avcon’s engineering and aircraft modification programs as well as general aviation customers.

P3.11.text: Butler Machine is an ITAR registered, ISO certified machine shop providing precision CNC machining, laser marking, and quality inspection

P1.1.text: Global Aviation Aftermarket Service Company | AerSale

P1.2.text: AerSale specializes in the sale and lease of aircraft and engines while providing a range of MRO, PMA, and engineering services for commercial aircraft.

P1.3.text: Aviation aftermarket support from first flight to final flight

P1.5.text: Integrated aviation solutions from nose to tail

P1.6.text: From maintenance and materials to sales and modifications, AerSale simplifies the complex—delivering complete support across the full aircraft lifecycle to save time and reduce costs.

P1.7.text: See in-stock aircraft, engines, landing gear, and APUs—ready to go.

P1.8.text: No middlemen. No needless markups. Just complete, connected service that keeps your fleet in the air.

P1.9.text: From component and airframe MRO to inventory, sales, asset management, and teardowns, AerSale connects every service you need—without the extra costs and headaches that come with managing multiple vendors. Our divisions work as one, eliminating inefficiencies, reducing turnaround times, and keeping your aftermarket strategy profitable, predictable, and ready for takeoff.

P1.11.text: From taxi to touchdown, AerAware delivers gate-to-gate visibility to support safer, more confident operations.

P1.13.text: Efficient, reliable, and fast to install, AerSafe meets mandates without long OEM lead times or costly modifications.

P1.15.text: FAA-certified and cost-effective, AerTrak minimizes downtime and works with most avionics for seamless ADS-B Out compliance.

P2.2.text: Discover AerSafe and AerTrak—AerSale’s proprietary, cost-effective solutions for FTFR and ADS-B Out compliance, developed through our in-house PMA facility.

P2.3.text: Certified aircraft modifications that reduce cost and extend service life

P2.4.text: Globally approved STCs developed in-house to solve real-world fleet challenges—with speed, simplicity, and savings.

P2.6.text: AerSale’s in-house modifications enhance aircraft performance, reduce ownership costs, and support compliance with FAA and global mandates—meeting today’s demanding fleet operational needs with certified and future-ready solutions across aircraft and component systems.

P2.7.text: We offer tailored STC solutions across interiors, avionics, and structural modifications—delivered quickly, cost-effectively, and operations-ready, with ongoing support every step of the way.

P2.8.text: FAA-certified STCs, PMA, and DER-driven solutions, with approvals from EASA, TCCA, CAAC, ANAC, and more.

P2.9.text: Engineered to meet or exceed regulatory mandates—without the price or lead time of OEM systems

P2.10.text: From engineering and testing to installation and support, AerSale delivers complete, in-house execution.

P2.11.text: Get certified solutions built around your fleet

P2.12.text: Let’s talk about modifications that reduce downtime, cut costs, and meet real operational needs.

P3.2.text: Led by respected industry professionals, AerSale is involved in nearly every aspect of the aviation aftermarket.

P3.3.text: Experts in aircraft, engines, components, and OEM alternatives

P3.4.text: Everything you need. One integrated company.

P3.5.text: We provide customers with complete lifecycle management to ensure reliability, drive efficiency, and create value.

P3.6.text: Nicolas Finazzo and Robert Nichols recognized an opportunity to provide premier mid-life aircraft and flight equipment support and founded AerSale. They hired a small staff of employees and began what would become a great acquisition of aircraft, engines, other companies, and facilities. Customers came—and stayed.

P3.7.text: See who we are and what we do—in less than 2 minutes.

P3.8.text: AerSale upholds the highest safety and compliance standards across its global network. With strategically positioned facilities, we deliver trusted solutions and seamless support—wherever our customers operate.

P3.9.text: See open jobs and join our talent network.
